question: Shillelagh and Shield Break Tweaks by Wallaby — send to Senate vote?
text:
Author: Wallaby
Post: https://discord.com/channels/766364534495117383/1286801164326797385/1531119990151843952
Doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Uwaph2CqFBs1GdGYraY3aYvQIWkjgApKk0mEauXIaIk/edit?tab=t.0
Summary:
- Moves Shillelagh to Druid rank 1, with the White-striking/Red-stabbing upgrade at rank 1 instead of rank 15.
- At rank 10+, Shillelagh also functions like Create/Destroy Magic Weapon.
- Clarifies Shield Break calls, damage colors, and tape markings.
answer-1: Yes
answer-2: No
answer-3: Abstain
name: Shillelagh and Shield Break Tweaks
notes: Never appeared on a reviewed Senate agenda. Despite an early label mentioning Weapon Master, the document contains no Weapon Master changes.
